fusions.name: Settling Weight
fusions.desc: Drops on the first enemy it meets, dealing 36 damage and bursting for 80% of that on every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Lulling Glide
fusions.desc: A glide from range that deals 4 damage, up to 1.5 times that at maximum range, with a 35% chance of [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Settled Roost
fusions.desc: For 4 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. Transcendent damage still lands.

fusions.name: Banked Slumber
fusions.desc: When your stamina runs out, you regain 20 stamina. Once every 40 seconds.
